The issuer shows adequate near-term liquidity (current ratio 1.27) and positive operating earnings, but the balance sheet is highly leveraged: liabilities are about 81% of assets and equity covers only a modest share of the capital structure. With EBIT of 3,639M against a very large liability base and only moderate asset protection, the credit profile looks more consistent with the upper speculative-grade range than investment grade.

DECISION: BB+
